<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#000000" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">
    <text x="18" y="24">9:41</text>
    <circle cx="314" cy="18" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="320" y="15" width="5" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="327" y="13" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="334" y="11" width="5" height="10" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="18" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="14" x2="358" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="18" x2="360" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="22" x2="356" y2="22" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="363" y="12" width="20" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <rect x="383" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="365" y="14" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="20" y="62" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Report Issue</text>
  <text x="20" y="84" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Help keep the community clean by sharing a quick report.</text>

  <!-- Top accent line -->
  <rect x="20" y="100" width="80" height="5" rx="100" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Category section -->
  <text x="20" y="132" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000DE">Select Categories:</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="144" width="104" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="72" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Hip of dirt</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="140" y="144" width="104" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="192" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Fairly Dirty</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="260" y="144" width="104" height="46" rx="23" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="312" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Very Dirty</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Upload section -->
  <text x="20" y="224" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000DE">Add a photo</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="236" width="350" height="218" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="34" y="250" width="322" height="150" rx="16" fill="#E9E9E9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="308" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="297" x2="195" y2="319" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="184" y1="308" x2="206" y2="308" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="170,347 184,329 197,341 212,322 225,347" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="332" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="395" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Click to upload a picture</text>
    <text x="195" y="416" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">OR</text>
    <text x="195" y="436" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Browse</text>
    <text x="195" y="458" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Supported: JPG, PNG up to 10MB</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Location section -->
  <text x="20" y="490" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000DE">Location details</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="502" width="350" height="38" rx="10" fill="#E9E9E9" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="521" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="525" x2="47" y2="530" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="58" y="526" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#757575">Enter your location...</text>
  </g>
  <text x="20" y="556" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#000000DE">Detect Location</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="566" width="350" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="594" r="14" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="594" x2="46" y2="594" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="588" x2="40" y2="600" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="62" y="588" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Current location</text>
    <text x="62" y="605" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">3 Adeniyi Jones Ave, Ikeja, Lagos</text>
    <text x="62" y="620" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Accuracy within 18 m</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra info cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="634" width="168" height="72" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="34" y="658" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Report summary</text>
    <text x="34" y="677" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Category: Very Dirty</text>
    <text x="34" y="695" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Photos: 1 attached</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="634" width="168" height="72" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="216" y="658" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Estimated response</text>
    <text x="216" y="677" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Within 24–48 hours</text>
    <text x="216" y="695" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Tracking ID: WST-20418</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Send button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="124" y="724" width="142" height="48" rx="10" fill="#000000" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="754" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Send</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" rx="20" fill="#E2E2E2"/>
    <g fill="#000000" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">
      <g transform="translate(34,772)">
        <polygon points="16,0 30,10 2,10" fill="#000000"/>
        <rect x="6" y="10" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="16" y="41" text-anchor="middle">Home</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(117,770)">
        <circle cx="16" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <rect x="10" y="16" width="12" height="14" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="16" y="41" text-anchor="middle">Payment</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(190,770)">
        <circle cx="16" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <rect x="8" y="18" width="16" height="12" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="16" y="41" text-anchor="middle">Report</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(265,770)">
        <circle cx="16" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <rect x="8" y="18" width="16" height="12" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="16" y="41" text-anchor="middle">Reward</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(342,770)">
        <circle cx="16" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <rect x="8" y="18" width="16" height="12" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="16" y="41" text-anchor="middle">Account</text>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="125" y="748" width="140" height="5" rx="100" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
